keybindings.toggle-skills-hint: The skill list placement can be selected in the module settings. When using a collapsible list, if the panel is already open, this will toggle skills open and closed and if the tray is not open, it will be opened with skills visible. When the skill list is placed at the bottom, this key will scroll to reveal the skill list.
keybindings.item-drag: Hold to drag items onto targets

keybindings.toggle-tray-hint: Toggle the visibility of the action tray
keybindings.open-actor-panel-hint: Open the Crux tray with the Actor panel visible

settings.tray-display-hint: Toggle - only hide tray when toggled (using hot key) / When token selected - Hide the tray if no tokens are selected, show otherwise / Automatic - Toggle for players, When token selected for the GM
settings.assume-default-character-hint: When no other token is selected, show the tray for the user's default character (usually only set for players). This can help with scenes with no tokens (or a generic party token) visible.
settings.use-control-button: Include a toggle button in token controls
settings.show-no-uses: Show items with no uses left
settings.show-unprepared-cantrips: Show cantrips even if they are not prepared
settings.skill-mode-hint: If "Collapsible at the top" is selected, the skill toggle hot key (in control settings) can be used to toggle the skill list open and closed, opening the panel if needed. If skills are at the bottom of the panel, the hotkey automatically scrolls to reveal them.
settings.skill-mode-append: At the bottom of the panel

settings.sub-sections-expanded-hint: Choose whether sub-sections (like spell levels) start open or collapsed by default

allow-player-scene-elevation.name: Allow Players Scene Elevation
allow-player-scene-elevation.hint: Allow players to use Scene elevation mode in the Crux elevation flyout. Players never see the scene level selection list.

auto-select-first-activity.name: Auto-select First Activity
auto-select-first-activity.hint: When enabled, Crux will automatically use the first activity without showing the activity selection dialog. When disabled, the system handles activity selection according to its own rules.

clear-targets-on-drag-target.name: Clear Targets on Drag Target
clear-targets-on-drag-target.hint: When enabled, dragging a Crux item onto a token clears previous targets before targeting the new token.

process-compendium-items.name: Process Compendium Items
process-compendium-items.hint: When enabled, Crux will process items in unlocked compendiums to set tray visibility flags. Disable this if you experience performance issues during startup.

exclude-container-items.name: Exclude Items Within Containers
exclude-container-items.hint: If enabled, items stored inside container items (like backpacks or pouches) will not be displayed in the Crux tray

ui.tray-visibility-hint: Control how this item appears in the Crux tray.
ui.rider-hint: Mark this activity as a rider that should not appear in the item use menu.

tray-mode.name: Tray Display Mode
tray-mode.hint: Toggle - only hide tray when toggled (using hot key) / When token selected - Hide the tray if no tokens are selected, show otherwise / Automatic - Toggle for players, When token selected for the GM

assume-default-character.name: Assume Default Character
assume-default-character.hint: When no other token is selected, show the tray for the user's default character (usually only set for players). This can help with scenes with no tokens (or a generic party token) visible.

allow-player-scene-elevation.name: Allow Players Scene Elevation
allow-player-scene-elevation.hint: Allow players to use Scene elevation mode in the Crux elevation flyout. Players never see the scene level selection list.

show-favorites-section.name: Show Favorites Section
show-favorites-section.hint: Display the Favorites section in the tray.

show-equipped-section.name: Show Equipped Section
show-equipped-section.hint: Display the Equipped section in the tray.

show-features-section.name: Show Features Section
show-features-section.hint: Display the Features section in the tray.

show-spells-section.name: Show Spells Section
show-spells-section.hint: Display the Spells section in the tray.

show-inventory-section.name: Show Inventory Section
show-inventory-section.hint: Display the Inventory section in the tray.

use-tidy5e-sections.name: Use Tidy 5e Sheet Sections
use-tidy5e-sections.hint: When enabled, recognizes and uses Tidy 5e Sheet sections instead of standard Crux sections.

show-quantity.name: Show Quantity (Q)
show-quantity.hint: Display the quantity indicator for items in the tray.

show-uses.name: Show Uses (U)
show-uses.hint: Display the uses indicator for items in the tray.

show-no-uses.name: Show Items With No Uses Left
show-no-uses.hint: Display items in the tray even when they have no remaining uses.

show-unprepared-cantrips.name: Show Unprepared Cantrips
show-unprepared-cantrips.hint: Show cantrips in the tray even if they are not prepared.

show-all-npc-items.name: Show All NPC Items
show-all-npc-items.hint: Display all items for NPCs in the tray, not just passive ones.

show-spell-dots.name: Show Spell Slot Dots
show-spell-dots.hint: Display dots indicating available spell slots.

show-spell-fractions.name: Show Spell Slot Numbers
show-spell-fractions.hint: Display numerical fractions showing available/maximum spell slots.

sort-alphabetic.name: Sort Items Alphabetically
sort-alphabetic.hint: Sort items in alphabetical order rather than by their default sorting.

exclude-container-items.name: Exclude Items Within Containers
exclude-container-items.hint: If enabled, items stored inside container items (like backpacks or pouches) will not be displayed in the Crux tray

skill-mode.name: Skill List Location
skill-mode.hint: If 'Collapsible at the top' is selected, the skill toggle hot key (in control settings) can be used to toggle the skill list open and closed, opening the panel if needed. If skills are at the bottom of the panel, the hotkey automatically scrolls to reveal them.

choices.append: At the bottom of the panel

skills-expanded.name: Skills Section Default State
skills-expanded.hint: Choose whether the Skills section starts expanded or collapsed by default

main-sections-expanded.name: Main Sections Default State
main-sections-expanded.hint: Choose whether the main sections (like Features, Spells, etc.) start expanded or collapsed by default

sub-sections-expanded.name: Sub-Sections Default State
sub-sections-expanded.hint: Choose whether sub-sections (like spell levels) start expanded or collapsed by default

icon-size.name: Icon Size
icon-size.hint: Set the size of icons in the tray.

tray-size.name: Tray Size
tray-size.hint: Set the overall size of the tray interface.

tab-height-multiplier.name: Tab Height Multiplier
tab-height-multiplier.hint: Adjust the vertical height of Crux tab buttons.

health-overlay-enabled.name: Enable Health Overlay
health-overlay-enabled.hint: Show a dynamic health overlay on character portraits

health-overlay-direction.name: Health Overlay Direction
health-overlay-direction.hint: Choose whether the health overlay fills up or down

font-family.name: Font Family
font-family.hint: Choose the font family used throughout the interface

custom-font-family.name: Custom Font Family
custom-font-family.hint: Specify a custom font family (only used when Font Family is set to 'Custom Font')

global-font-size-multiplier.name: Global Font Size Multiplier
global-font-size-multiplier.hint: Adjust the size of all text in the interface. 1.0 is the recommended default scale.

content-text-size-multiplier.name: Content Text Size Multiplier
content-text-size-multiplier.hint: Adjust the size of content text elements like item descriptions, abilities, and skills while maintaining proportions (0.5 = half size, 1.0 = default, 1.5 = 50% larger)

character-name-size-multiplier.name: Character Name Size Multiplier
character-name-size-multiplier.hint: Adjust the size of character names in the interface (0.5 = half size, 1.0 = default, 1.5 = 50% larger). This setting is independent of other font size settings.

actor-ability-text-size-multiplier.name: Actor Ability Text Size Multiplier
actor-ability-text-size-multiplier.hint: Adjust only the Actor Panel ability button text size. Use this if ability buttons overflow the portrait area.

visual-preset.name: Visual Preset
visual-preset.hint: Choose a visual style for Crux. Changing this also moves Panel Opacity to the preset default.

panel-opacity.name: Panel Opacity
panel-opacity.hint: Adjust the background opacity of the Crux panel backdrop.

element-opacity.name: Element Opacity
element-opacity.hint: Adjust the background opacity of Crux cards, buttons, tabs, and boxed controls.

panel-blur.name: Panel Blur
panel-blur.hint: Adjust the glass blur behind the Crux panel. 0 disables blur.

taskbar-compatibility.name: Taskbar Compatibility
taskbar-compatibility.hint: Enable compatibility with the Taskbar module (Requires Refresh)

empty-tray-icon.name: Empty Tray Icon
empty-tray-icon.hint: Choose the icon to display when the tray is empty

auto-select-first-activity.name: Auto-select First Activity
auto-select-first-activity.hint: When enabled, Crux will automatically use the first activity without showing the activity selection dialog. When disabled, the system handles activity selection according to its own rules.

clear-targets-on-drag-target.name: Clear Targets on Drag Target
clear-targets-on-drag-target.hint: When enabled, dragging a Crux item onto a token clears previous targets before targeting the new token.

process-compendium-items.name: Process Compendium Items
process-compendium-items.hint: When enabled, Crux will process items in unlocked compendiums to set tray visibility flags. Disable this if you experience performance issues during startup.
